benefits.heading: Family Cover
benefits.text: Choose family floater plans and get coverage for all your family members. One policy allows umbrella coverage to all your loved ones, so that if anyone falls ill, the policy covers the medical costs. This means that you can rest assured that your family will be taken care of, even in your absence. Some family cover plans also work out to be more affordable, rather than getting individual plans for each family member.

benefits.heading: The right coverage benefits
benefits.text: Check the coverage benefits that the health insurance plans offer. Choose a plan which offers the most inclusive scope of coverage that also matches your needs. It's tempting to pick a policy with the least premium, but make sure you check the coverage benefits first.

benefits.heading: The right premium
benefits.text: Nothing is more important than affordable premiums. So, check the coverage and ensure that the premium is commensurate with the coverage provided. Also, ensure that the premium is affordable for you. Since premiums will need to be paid every year or every few years (depending on the terms of the policy), make sure you keep funds aside so that you don't have to run around at the last minute.
